hero.en: 18 names traded unusually dark in the settled session; in 12 of them the hidden volume showed up while the price was rising. Across the desk, 40% of dollar volume printed off-exchange.
hero.zh: 18 只个股场外成交异常偏重，其中 12 只是在股价上涨时出现的。全盘来看，40% 的成交金额发生在场外。

read.en: An unusual amount of these names' volume printed away from the public tape while the price fell. Someone took the other side of that selling — the tape cannot say who, or whether they were early.
read.zh: 这些个股有异常高比例的成交发生在公开盘面之外，同时股价下跌。有人承接了这些卖盘——但成交数据无法说明是谁，也无法说明他们是否过早入场。

watch.en: Watching whether the hidden volume keeps up once the price stops falling.
watch.zh: 观察股价止跌后，暗池成交是否仍然维持。

read.en: Heavy off-exchange volume alongside a rising price. Big orders were being worked while the name was already moving up — which is as consistent with sellers meeting demand as with buyers chasing.
read.zh: 场外成交沉重，同时股价上涨。大单在股价已经上行时被执行——这既可能是卖方在满足需求，也可能是买方在追高。

watch.en: Watching whether the off-exchange share fades as the move extends.
watch.zh: 观察随着涨势延伸，场外占比是否回落。

read.en: Unusually heavy hidden volume with the price going nowhere. Large size changed hands without moving the quote, which is what working an order quietly is supposed to look like.
read.zh: 暗池成交异常沉重，但股价几乎未动。大量筹码易手却没有推动报价——这正是悄然执行大单应有的样子。

watch.en: Watching which way the quote breaks once the size stops printing.
watch.zh: 观察大额成交结束后，报价向哪个方向突破。
